headlines.title: GE Vernova and Venture Global Sign a Power Deal Worth Up to $17.2 Billion. Here’s What’s Firm
headlines.summary: GE Vernova (GEV:NYSE) is one of two suppliers on a power deal Venture Global (VG:NYSE) announced today, October 15, covering up to 16 gas-fired power islands of 720 megawatts each for its LNG sites and potential AI data centers. The headline number is bigger than the firm commitment.

headlines.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Is Down 5.5% After Major AI Power Deal With Venture Global – Has The Bull Case Changed?
headlines.summary: Earlier this week, Venture Global announced power and grid frame agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes for up to 16 new 720 MW combined-cycle gas power island units and associated transformer equipment, supporting an off-grid industrial power network that could underpin as much as 10 GW of future compute capacity.

headlines.title: VG Stock Rises Premarket On GE Vernova, Baker Hughes Power Deals – Traders Eye This Crucial Resistance Level
headlines.summary: Venture Global signed agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes to develop up to 16 new power units, with 720 megawatts of capacity each.

headlines.title: Is GE Vernova (GEV) Undervalued After Raising Guidance And Landing Data Center Power Deals?
headlines.summary: GE Vernova (GEV) is back in focus after strong organic order growth, higher 2026 revenue and free cash flow guidance, and fresh data center linked power deals with Venture Global. Despite the latest pullback, with a 1-day share price return down 6.2% and a 7-day share price return down 5.6% as AI infrastructure stocks sold off, GE Vernova still carries a 30-day share price gain of 7.7% and a year to date share price return of 38.6%. headlines.title: Is GE Vernova Stock Still Telling You The Same Thing?
headlines.summary: Shares of GE Vernova (GEV) returned 66.5% in the twelve months to October 13, 2026, outpacing the 20.5% return for the S&P 500. During that period, orders consistently increased at the company's Power and Electrification businesses, and management raised its 2026 revenue forecast twice. Those orders appear to be what investors were paying for. So what could you have seen of those orders before the twelve months began, on October 10, 2025.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
